name: Portallic Critical (Critical)
body:
Every time you execute a powerful blow, the adrenaline strengthens your focus and enhances your ability to maneuver between dimensions.

Prerequisite(s): Critical Focus, create portal class feature.

Benefit(s): When you confirm a critical hit with a melee strike after exiting a portal that same round, you gain one additional portal for use that day.

Special: You can only apply the effects of one critical feat to a given critical hit unless you possess Critical Mastery.
